gen-gf-oxanium-gf-aclonica: Aclonica stretches out wide and deep-bodied, a plain sans with loose spacing. Oxanium's big lowercase and unbroken single-line strokes sit above it, sharp where Aclonica is relaxed, so the page has a clear top and a settled bottom.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-allerta: Oxanium goes boldly pen-drawn, every stroke a single line. Allerta runs wide and loose with a prominent x-height, so extended reading moves along without crowding.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-alumni-sans: Distinctive up top, Oxanium keeps one marker-like line throughout. It earns its keep big and short, while Alumni Sans adds a slight, stone-carved heft change to the text beneath it.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Big lowercase, daylight in the curves: that's Oxanium. Alumni Sans Pinstripe tightens the word texture and sets oversized lowercase against small capitals, giving the heading something compact to lean on.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Oxanium keeps its stroke monoline from stem to finish. It is best at commanding big, bold lines, while Alumni Sans SC does its quiet work with squeezed letters and stems just heavier than hairlines.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-anaheim: Modern and approachable, Anaheim runs dense and rounded. Oxanium is the one for commanding display, with curves and stems moving in lockstep, while Anaheim fills the line with lowercase that looks like capitals.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-arsenal: A big lowercase defines Oxanium, with curves ending in clear daylight. Arsenal counters with tempered stroke modulation and a close-knit line, so a full page of text goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-arsenal-sc: Arsenal SC sets its letters tight, with a faint thick-thin shift and a wide-cut mouth. Arsenal SC's low-to-medium contrast makes the neatest foil for Oxanium's flat monoweight stroke throughout.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-asimovian: Approachable text sits under Oxanium's commanding headline, all unbroken monoline strokes. Asimovian builds tall-bodied letters from a single stroke width, so paragraph after paragraph goes down plainly.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-basic: Oxanium brings big lowercase and a single steady line thickness. And Basic reads smoothly over many lines, with only a gentle bump from small letters up to capitals.
